scripts.build:artifact: tsc -b && vite build --mode artifact --outDir dist-artifact && node scripts/build-artifact.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.check:xhs: npm run build:xhs && node xhs/preview.mjs && node xhs/check-oldkernel.mjs && node xhs/check-oldcss.mjs
scripts.check:vsweb: npm run build && npm run build:xhs && node xhs/preview.mjs && node xhs/check-vsweb.mjs
scripts.check:xhs:all: npm run check:vsweb && node xhs/check-oldkernel.mjs && node xhs/check-oldcss.mjs && node xhs/check-submit.mjs
